# SB-1013 — Safety bulletin: airborne dust from blasting

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-RR01

Hazard description
Airborne particulate generated during abrasive blasting operations can present inhalation, eye, and skin exposure risks for operators and nearby personnel. Fine dust from spent abrasives and scale may contain metallic oxides and residual process chemicals. Dust generation increases during containment breaches, transfer of spent media, and when maintenance requires removal of guards or covers. Particles can be re-entrained by draft and ventilation flow, extending the hazard footprint beyond the immediate blast area. Uncontrolled dust also increases fire and secondary contamination risk in adjacent processes.

Affected equipment
Primary: Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) located on line P2-L1 at Plant P2. Maintenance tasks that expose the mandrel, ring surface, or internal housings are high-risk for dust release. Note: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L1-RR01) is 430 N·m. Refer to MM-P2-L1-RR01 for mechanical maintenance requirements and locking procedures before any access.

Required controls
- Administrative: Restrict blasting and media handling to designated blasting shifts and notify adjacent work areas. Coordinate with maintenance per SOP-P2-L1-05 for pre-work isolation and permit requirements. Train personnel on hazard recognition and controls described in SB-1030.
- Engineering: Use local exhaust ventilation with capture at source. Where feasible, conduct blasting within enclosed booths or negative-pressure enclosures to prevent migration to the mill and nearby processes.
- Work practices: Wet suppression or vacuum-assisted media recovery must be used during cleanup to minimize re-entrainment. Establish controlled transfer routes for spent media away from EQ-P2-L1-RR01.
- PPE: Mandatory respiratory protection selection and eye protection per site respiratory and eye protection matrix; use protective clothing to prevent skin contamination and change-out procedures to avoid cross-contamination.
- Verification: Supervisors must confirm completion of SOP-P2-L1-05 isolation steps and reference MM-P2-L1-RR01 torque control when reassembling components.

Effective date
This bulletin is effective immediately upon issue; all affected work planning and maintenance activities at Plant P2, line P2-L1 must comply prior to commencing blasting or related cleanup.
